edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Check it before every step-up. - W Pale Cascade is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Crescent Strike is 8s at rank 1: Moonlight marks reset her dash, so sidestep the arc and her dive loses its follow-up. - Lunar Rush is 22s with no mark. - Pale Cascade is 15s, the lifeline. - Moonfall is 100s: fights, not waves.
